definitions.gloss: Chinese classics; Sinology; study of Chinese classical texts
definitions.explanation: The academic study of classical Chinese literature, philosophy, and history, particularly as practiced in pre-modern Japan. In the Edo period, {漢学|かんがく} was one of the main branches of scholarship alongside {国学|こくがく} (native Japanese studies) and {蘭学|らんがく} (Dutch/Western studies).

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{漢学|かんがく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教養|きょうよう}→教養：09788_kyouyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the Edo period, Chinese classical studies were considered part of a samurai's education.

examples.japanese: {漢学|かんがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素養|そよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{漢詩|かんし}→漢詩：13438_kanshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{解|と}ける→読み解く：14246_yomitoku⟧。
examples.english: People with a grounding in Chinese classics can read and interpret Chinese poetry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧になって⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧⟦{学問|がくもん}→学問：02604_gakumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まる→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{漢学|かんがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{地位|ちい}→地位：03427_chii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}って→失う：01887_ushinau⟧いった。
examples.english: As Western learning spread in the Meiji era, Chinese classical studies gradually lost their status.

notes:
Compound of {漢|かん} ('China; Chinese; Han') and ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ ('study; learning'). Refers primarily to the Japanese tradition of studying Chinese classical texts — Confucian writings, Chinese poetry, and historical works — which was central to intellectual life from the Nara period through the Meiji era.

USAGE:
- In historical contexts, refers to the Edo-period scholarly tradition alongside {国学|こくがく} and {蘭学|らんがく}
- In modern usage, may refer more broadly to Chinese studies or Sinology in academic settings
- The scholar who practices {漢学|かんがく} is called a {漢学者|かんがくしゃ}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漢学|かんがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素養|そよう}: grounding in Chinese classics
- {漢学|かんがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to study Chinese classics
- {漢学者|かんがくしゃ}: scholar of Chinese classics; Sinologist
- {漢学|かんがく}⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧: academy for Chinese classical studies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国学|こくがく}: Japanese classical studies — the study of ancient Japanese texts, literature, and Shinto, developed in contrast to Chinese learning
- {蘭学|らんがく}: Dutch studies; Western learning — the study of Western science and medicine through Dutch sources in the Edo period
- ⟦{中国学|ちゅうごくがく}→中国学：29297_chuugokugaku⟧: Chinese studies — the modern academic discipline studying China more broadly, including modern history and society
